name: Mils bei Imst
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful scattered settlement between Imst and the Fernpass – famous for its Baroque church and panoramic views.
beschreibung:
Mils bei Imst is situated at an elevation of 743 meters on the right bank of the Inn River in the district of Imst, positioned between the town of Imst to the west and the scenic Fern Pass highway route to the east. Home to around 600 residents, the quiet village stretches out along the sunny slopes beneath the imposing Mount Tschirgant (2,370 m), which guards the settlement to the north. The Inn River flows closely through the narrow valley, naturally separating Mils from neighboring Imst.

The centerpiece of the community is the baroque parish church dedicated to St. Peter, renowned for its slender bell tower and well-preserved 18th-century ceiling frescoes, making it an architectural gem of the Tyrolean Oberland. Outdoor enthusiasts treasure Mils as a serene base for demanding climbs up the Tschirgant via ferrata or for relaxed family hikes along the riverside paths of the Inn Valley.

With its sunny hillside terraces, open panoramic vistas, and proximity to regional natural parks, Mils bei Imst offers pure alpine calm and a refreshing escape from busy travel routes.
